output.one_liner: Create and manage advertising campaigns and account data across Google Search, Display, YouTube and other channels.

auth.notes: Supports OAuth 2.0 for user authentication (single and multi-user) and service account workflows. OAuth client setup required via Google Cloud Console.

evidence.snippet: Google Ads API utilizes the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication and authorization, allowing your app to access user accounts.
Access token & refresh token represents the user's authorization to let the app access their Google Ads account on their behalf.

access.notes: Test access is freely available. Production access requires applying for and receiving approval for access levels (Explorer, Basic, or Standard).

evidence.snippet: To use production Ads accounts, open the Google Ads API Overview page for your Cloud project and apply for Explorer access.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Rate limited by queries per second (QPS) per customer ID and developer token using Token Bucket algorithm

evidence.snippet: Services include ConversionValueRuleService, CustomerAssetService, KeywordPlanService, RecommendationService, and many others.
Upload click, call, and enhanced conversions and configure automated bidding strategies.
Google Ads API rate limits requests by queries per second (QPS) per client customer ID and developer token using a Token Bucket algorithm.
After the user clicks on an ad and submits the lead form, an HTTP POST request gets sent to the configured URL.
The Google Ads MCP server provides a standardized bridge to the Google Ads API. Install via pipx install google-ads-mcp.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve OAuth and test access available, but production multi-customer use requires API access level approval; Composio toolkit with 78 tools already built.

overview_evidence.snippet: Create and manage ads that reach users looking for your products or services on Google Search, Display, YouTube and more.
Tools: 78, Auth: OAUTH2, Composio-managed OAuth available? Yes, Category: ads & conversion

unknown_reasons.mcp: Official MCP server confirmed to exist; specific repository URL not explicitly provided in pages, only package name google-ads-mcp
